notes.title: Patch 1.05, MacOS compatibility
notes.content:
Good afternoon everybody,

I hope everyone is having a good weekend! Recently, it came to our attention that the game would not open on MacOS. After doing some research and testing, I found that this was due to the Mac export option on Construct 2 (the game engine that SoA is built in) currently being unstable and required a work-around to get it to function properly. I apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused some of our Mac users, as this was not the case when the game initially launched, so I was unaware of the recent Mac export stability issues.

This update fixes the Mac compatibility problem that some of you may have experienced recently. Also, shoutout to Steam user ianexBY55 for bringing this issue to our attention!

And of course, if anybody runs into any more issues, please feel free to post a topic in the discussions so we can look into it for you. Thank you and happy gaming! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Winter Update - Achievements and New Music!
notes.content:
Greetings Dungeoneers!

It has been a little quiet on our end lately, but we now have a pretty exciting update for you. Version 1.04 of the game now includes Steam Achievements and updated music throughout the game! So, if you have already played through the game, now is a perfect time to go back in, discover some new music tracks and earn those achievements. If you haven't played it yet, it's a great time for you to jump in and try it out. Full patch notes below:


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 16 Steam Achievements to earn in-game
[*]Updated main menu theme song
[*]Updated Royal Crypts music
[*]New Ice Caverns music
[*]Updated Skill Shop music
[*]Updated Final Boss music
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the final boss mini-map marker would not disappear after defeating the boss
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]The bonus chests in the Ancient Ruins dungeon might appear at incorrect times
[*]Breaking object sounds might occasionally cut out
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed an issue where the final boss mini-map marker would not disappear after defeating the boss

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
As stated in the last patch notes, I said I'd be updating to fix the keyboard/mouse dashing bug. Well here it is! Patch notes below:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where you could dash through doors when playing with a keyboard and mouse. (I've done some extensive testing on this and have not been able to re-create the bug since I implemented the fix, so it should be completely fixed. BUT if anyone still runs into this issue after updating, please let me know in the comments or in a separate discussion thread so I can look into it. Thanks)

[b]Known Issues[/b]

The bonus chests in the Ancient Ruins dungeon might appear at incorrect times

notes.title: Patch 1.02 available
notes.content:
Just pushed a super small update - patch notes below:

[b] Bug Fixes [/b]

Fixed an issue where after loading a previous saved game, if you tried to go to the next dungeon it would sometimes boot you out to the main menu.

[b] Known Issues [/b]

[list]
[*]The bonus chests in the Ancient Ruins dungeon might appear at incorrect times
[*]When playing with a keyboard/mouse, it is unfortunately possible to dash through closed doors. If this happens to you, you should be able to dash back into the room. This is a major issue I will be fixing in the next patch, hopefully by the end of this weekend (10/22). In the meantime, I would recommend playing with a controller
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings Dungeon Crawlers!

We just pushed a small update to address some issues with the game, particularly in co-op mode. Check it out! Full patch notes below:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the Eruption skill and the Ground Smash skill would not work for player 2
[*]Fixed a major issue where one of the final boss attacks would not act correctly
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*]Players now have the ability to revive themselves with a potion during the final boss fight
[*]Slightly increased the Paladin's base damage and attack speed
[*]Increased the overall damage output in co-op mode
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]The bonus chests in the Ancient Ruins dungeon might appear at incorrect times
